_comment: Hand-curated Soobin vlogs / VLIVEs that are NOT in the source YouTube
resolves each id against YouTube and appends it to playlist.json, so a
refresh keeps them instead of wiping them.
- solo Soobin only, to match the rest of the playlist (a live he shares
with another member is a different thing to study to)
- long-form (the shortest entry in the playlist is ~21 min)
- one entry per broadcast. The same VLIVE is re-uploaded by several
channels under different titles; cross-check the DURATION against the
existing entries before adding, not just the video id.
- prefer the channels the playlist already draws on (TXT official,
Moa's Diary, V Live) over unknown re-uploaders, which are likelier to
be taken down or have embedding disabled.
